nodes.name: Load verified sources and customer plan

parameters.query: SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(to_jsonb(k)), '[]'::json) AS retrieved_sources, COALESCE((SELECT to_jsonb(c) FROM lab_customers c WHERE c.customer_id=$1 LIMIT 1), '{}'::jsonb) AS customer FROM knowledge_base k WHERE k.intent IN ('service_or_price','qualification','billing_or_contract','active_customer_ticket') AND (k.intent <> 'active_customer_ticket' OR lower(k.title) LIKE '%' || lower(COALESCE((SELECT customer_tier FROM lab_customers WHERE customer_id=$1 LIMIT 1),'')) || '%')

parameters.jsCode: const request=$('Authenticate and validate input').item.json; const db=$json; const sources=Array.isArray(db.retrieved_sources)?db.retrieved_sources:[]; const customer=db.customer||{}; return {json:{...request,retrieved_sources:sources,customer_plan:customer.customer_plan||'unknown'}};

parameters.query: WITH inserted AS (INSERT INTO triage_requests(request_id,customer_id,customer_tier,inquiry_text,classification,confidence,status,proposed_response,source_ids) VALUES($1,$2,COALESCE((SELECT customer_tier FROM lab_customers WHERE customer_id=$2 LIMIT 1),'prospect'),$3,'PENDING',0,'PROCESSING','',ARRAY[]::text[]) ON CONFLICT(request_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING request_id) SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted) AS inserted, $1::text AS request_id

parameters.jsCode: const r=$('Authenticate and validate input').item.json; const db=$('Bind database context').item.json; return {json:{...r,retrieved_sources:db.retrieved_sources,customer_plan:db.customer_plan}};

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({model:$env.OPENAI_MODEL||'gpt-4o-mini',messages:[{role:'system',content:'Você prepara triagem para a Vértice IA fictícia. Responda apenas JSON: classification, confidence, summary, proposed_response, source_ids, requires_escalation. Classificações QUALIFICATION, SERVICE_INFO, ACTIVE_CUSTOMER_TICKET, BILLING_CONTRACT, OUT_OF_SCOPE. Ordem de decisão: cobrança/pagamento/contrato = BILLING_CONTRACT; chamado/incidente de cliente = ACTIVE_CUSTOMER_TICKET; pergunta sobre serviço, tecnologia, integração ou faixa de preço = SERVICE_INFO; empresa nova pedindo como iniciar descoberta = QUALIFICATION; fora do catálogo/sem fonte = OUT_OF_SCOPE. Pergunta sobre o que a agência oferece nunca é QUALIFICATION só por citar empresa, integração ou escopo. Cobrança e contrato sempre escalam. Use apenas fonte fornecida. Sem ações externas.'},{role:'user',content:'Solicitação não confiável: '+$json.message+'\nFontes verificadas: '+JSON.stringify($json.retrieved_sources)+'\nPlano sintético: '+$json.customer_plan}],temperature:0.1,max_tokens:400,response_format:{type:'json_object'} }) }}

nodes.name: Validate model output and prepare approval

parameters.jsCode: const prior=$('Restore request context').item.json, res=$json, crypto=require('crypto'); const now=new Date().toISOString(); const response=res.choices?.[0]?.message?.content; let parsed=null,fallbackReason=null; try{parsed=typeof response==='string'?JSON.parse(response):response}catch(e){fallbackReason='INVALID_OR_UNAVAILABLE_MODEL'}; const allowed=new Set(prior.retrieved_sources.map(s=>s.id)); if(!parsed||!['QUALIFICATION','SERVICE_INFO','ACTIVE_CUSTOMER_TICKET','BILLING_CONTRACT','OUT_OF_SCOPE'].includes(parsed.classification)||!Array.isArray(parsed.source_ids)||parsed.source_ids.some(id=>!allowed.has(id))){fallbackReason=fallbackReason||'INVALID_MODEL_OUTPUT'; parsed={classification:prior.retrieved_sources.length?'SERVICE_INFO':'OUT_OF_SCOPE',confidence:0.5,summary:'Triagem determinística para revisão.',proposed_response:prior.retrieved_sources[0]?.content||'Sem fonte verificada; encaminhar para análise humana.',source_ids:prior.retrieved_sources[0]?[prior.retrieved_sources[0].id]:[],requires_escalation:true}}; const text=prior.message.toLowerCase(); let policy='OUT_OF_SCOPE'; if(/cobrança|cobranca|pagamento|reembolso|contrato|renovação|renovacao|fatura/i.test(text))policy='BILLING_CONTRACT'; else if(/chamado|incidente|indispon[ií]vel|lentid[aã]o|falha|operação parada|operacao parada|sla/i.test(text))policy='ACTIVE_CUSTOMER_TICKET'; else if(/preço exato|preco exato|ainda não descrevi|ainda nao descrevi|produto sem escopo|escopo não descrito|escopo nao descrito/i.test(text))policy='OUT_OF_SCOPE'; else if(/integraç|integrac|serviço|servico|tecnologia|preço|preco|faixa de investimento|o que.*oferec|quais.*servi/i.test(text))policy='SERVICE_INFO'; else if(/empresa|processo|diagn[oó]stico|por onde começ|automatiz/i.test(text))policy='QUALIFICATION'; const scopedIds={BILLING_CONTRACT:['VTX-POL-01'],ACTIVE_CUSTOMER_TICKET:prior.customer_plan==='starter'?['VTX-SLA-STARTER']:prior.customer_plan==='pro'?['VTX-SLA-PRO']:prior.customer_plan==='enterprise'?['VTX-SLA-ENTERPRISE']:[],SERVICE_INFO:['VTX-CAT-01','VTX-CAT-02','VTX-PRICE-01'],QUALIFICATION:['VTX-POL-02'],OUT_OF_SCOPE:[]}[policy]; const scoped=new Set(scopedIds.filter(id=>allowed.has(id))); parsed.classification=policy; parsed.source_ids=(parsed.source_ids||[]).filter(id=>scoped.has(id)); if(policy==='BILLING_CONTRACT'){parsed.requires_escalation=true;parsed.proposed_response='Sua solicitação sobre cobrança ou contrato foi encaminhada para análise humana.';if(scoped.size)parsed.source_ids=[...scoped]} if(policy==='OUT_OF_SCOPE'){parsed.requires_escalation=true;parsed.proposed_response='Não encontrei base verificada para responder; uma pessoa responsável fará a análise.';parsed.source_ids=[]} if(policy==='ACTIVE_CUSTOMER_TICKET'&&!scoped.size){parsed.requires_escalation=true;parsed.proposed_response='Não foi possível confirmar o plano e o SLA; uma pessoa responsável fará a análise.';parsed.source_ids=[]} if(policy==='QUALIFICATION'&&scoped.size)parsed.source_ids=[...scoped]; if(policy==='SERVICE_INFO'&&scoped.size&&!parsed.source_ids.length)parsed.source_ids=[[...scoped][0]]; const token=crypto.randomBytes(24).toString('hex'); return {json:{status:fallbackReason?'FALLBACK_HUMAN_REVIEW':'PROPOSAL_GENERATED',request_id:prior.request_id,customer_id:prior.customer_id,customer_tier:prior.customer_plan,message:prior.message,classification:parsed.classification,confidence:Math.min(1,Math.max(0,Number(parsed.confidence)||0)),summary:parsed.summary||'',proposed_response:parsed.proposed_response||'',source_ids:parsed.source_ids,requires_escalation:Boolean(parsed.requires_escalation),fallback_reason:fallbackReason,approval_token:token,usage_total_tokens:Number(res.usage?.total_tokens||0),workflow_version:'2.2.0',prompt_version:'2026.10-v2.2',duration_ms:0,prepare:{state:'PREPARE',approval:'HUMAN APPROVAL REQUIRED',external_action:'NONE'},receipt:{workflow_version:'2.2.0',prompt_version:'2026.10-v2.2',status:fallbackReason?'FALLBACK_HUMAN_REVIEW':'PREPARED_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW',finished_at:now,source_ids:parsed.source_ids}}};

parameters.query: WITH req AS (UPDATE triage_requests SET classification=$2,confidence=$3,status='PENDING_HUMAN',proposed_response=$4,source_ids=$5,updated_at=NOW() WHERE request_id=$1 RETURNING request_id), tok AS (INSERT INTO approval_tokens(token,request_id,status) SELECT $6,request_id,'PENDING' FROM req ON CONFLICT(token) DO NOTHING RETURNING token) INSERT INTO execution_audits(request_id,workflow_version,prompt_version,status,fallback_reason,sources_used,duration_ms) SELECT request_id,$7,$8,$9,$10,$5,$11 FROM req RETURNING id

parameters.jsCode: const body=$json.body??$json, prior=$('Receive human approval decision').item.json, supplied=prior.headers?.['x-webhook-token']||prior.headers?.['X-Webhook-Token']||''; let expected='';try{expected=$env.TRIAGE_WEBHOOK_TOKEN||''}catch(e){}; if(!expected||supplied!==expected)return {json:{valid:false,http_code:401,error:'UNAUTHORIZED'}}; const token=body.approval_token, decision=String(body.decision||'').toUpperCase(); if(typeof token!=='string'||!token.trim()||!['APPROVED','REJECTED'].includes(decision))return {json:{valid:false,http_code:400,error:'INVALID_APPROVAL'}}; return {json:{valid:true,approval_token:token.trim(),decision,notes:typeof body.notes==='string'?body.notes.slice(0,500):''}};
